title: Rust
description: Rust projects: crates.io, rustup's downloads and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Rust
de.description: Rust-Projekte: crates.io, die Downloads von rustup und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The toolchain: rustup into the sandbox's HOME, kept with the start (curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh -s -- -y), or Debian's older cargo in an image variant: sandbox-ai images new rust --from claude, sandbox-ai images extend rust --add-apt cargo, sandbox-ai build --variant rust, then start with --image-variant rust.
A build needs memory: --memory 16g on the command line for a large workspace.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
